links.outcome: Patient with schizophrenia misattributing intent to LLM chatbot output, preceding psychotic relapse
links.effect: Single case: generic safety tips were read as personalized 'signals', leading to checking behaviors, stopping paliperidone, and relapse (PANSS 102, BPRS 58).
links.quote: In this case, neutral safety statements produced by an LLM were seemingly reinterpreted as personally targeted messages, likely through the combined influence of anthropomorphic attributions, aberrant salience, and reasoning biases.

unlisted_practices: Structured assessment of digital media use, including AI chatbot interactions, in routine psychiatric evaluations
Addressing misinterpretations of chatbot output in the therapeutic dialogue

screen.reason: Single-patient case report detailing adverse psychiatric outcomes (psychotic relapse) following real-world interaction with ChatGPT; does not test a specific deployment safeguard.
